items.q: How does the free trial work?
items.a: You use a paid plan free for 14 days, without a credit card. After that your subscription starts on the plan you chose. If you've set up a direct debit or card, it's paid automatically; otherwise you get a payment request by email. Your webshop always stays online. If it remains unpaid after reminders and a grace period, you can no longer make changes in your admin. Free and Events Flex need no trial: they cost nothing per month.

items.q: How do I pay my subscription?
items.a: In your admin under Subscription you set up a SEPA direct debit or a card, so every period is paid automatically. Prefer not to? Then you receive a payment request each period that you pay via a link. You only get the invoice after payment.

items.q: Can I switch plans or stop later?
items.a: Yes, in your admin under Subscription, with no notice period. An upgrade takes effect once the difference for the current period is paid. A downgrade takes effect at the next period. If you stop and move to Free, your paid subscription ends immediately.

An ordering site for pickup and delivery, ordering at the table via QR, a kitchen screen, the POS, extras and allergens, for €49 per month. If you'd like us to add your menu and set everything up, there's a one-off €149 setup package.
Nothing per month and €0.49 per paid ticket, with no percentage. The fee is deducted automatically from the online payment. Free tickets cost nothing. Tickets on Events Flex are paid online.

items.q: Are there extra costs on top of the subscription?
items.a: SellQo charges nothing per order, except the ticket fee on Events Flex. If your customer pays online, Stripe charges its usual rates on your own Stripe account. A bank transfer with a QR code costs you nothing.

items.q: Which payment methods can I offer?
items.a: Through your own Stripe account: Bancontact, iDEAL, card, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Also bank transfer with a QR code and, for hospitality, paying on pickup or at the counter. The money goes straight to you.

items.q: Can I sell in store too?
items.a: Yes. The POS uses the same products, prices and stock as your webshop, with receipts and an end-of-day report. It's included in Pro, Enterprise and the Hospitality plan.

The admin is available in Dutch, English, French, German and Ukrainian. Customer emails go out in Dutch, English, French or German. Invoices are in Dutch, with the VAT note in your customer's language. The standard webshop is in Dutch today; more languages will follow.

items.q: Can I move my existing webshop?
items.a: Yes. You import products, customers and orders with CSV or Excel exports from Shopify, WooCommerce and other platforms. On Enterprise we help you with the move.

items.q: What is Peppol and do I need it?
items.a: Since 1 January 2026, e-invoicing via Peppol is mandatory between Belgian businesses. With the Odoo integration (from Pro), your B2B invoices go via Peppol. If you only sell to consumers, you don't need it.

items.q: What happens to my data if I stop?
items.a: Your data stays yours. You export your orders as CSV and your stock as Excel; for a full export we'll help you. If you ask, we delete your account and data completely.

discount_code_case_insensitive.title: Discount codes are no longer case-sensitive
discount_code_case_insensitive.description: If a customer types "welcome10" while your code is called "WELCOME10", it is now simply accepted. Upper case, lower case and extra spaces no longer make a difference. In your webshop and on your invoices the code still appears exactly as you created it.

event_scanner_access_management.title: Door access and scan QR codes per event
event_scanner_access_management.description: The event page has a new Access tab. There you create a separate scan access per door or volunteer, with a zone, a direction (in, out or both), a scan mode and optionally a restriction to specific ticket types and an expiry date. You immediately get a QR code and a link to forward to the person at the door. The list shows how often each access has been used and when it was last used. What does this mean for you? You never have to share your own login: each access has its own code that you revoke with one click, after which scanning with that code stops immediately. A revoked access stays in the list, so you can still see who scanned what. An access that has never been used can be deleted permanently.

event_detail_page.title: Event page with attendees and check-in overview
event_detail_page.description: Click a date in the event overview and you now open a dedicated event page. It shows capacity, tickets sold, who is inside right now and how many spots are left, plus your ticket types with price and sales status. The Attendees tab lists each visitor's name, email, ticket type, order number and whether they are inside or outside. The Scan log tab shows every scan with time, direction, zone and result.

settings_multilingual.title: Most settings screens are now multilingual
settings_multilingual.description: When you switch language, the screens for your profile, team members, company details, branding, domains, notifications and the email, WhatsApp and social media connections now appear in that language. The screens for VAT, payments and shipping will follow in a future update.

auth_navigation_multilingual.title: The sign-in screen and menu now speak your language
auth_navigation_multilingual.description: The sign-in screen, the registration form, password recovery and the entire navigation menu now appear in the language you choose. You set that language under My profile.

ukrainian_language.title: SellQo is now available in Ukrainian
ukrainian_language.description: Alongside Dutch, English, French and German, you can now use SellQo in Ukrainian. You choose your own language in your profile settings. Visitors to the public website, and to a webshop that offers Ukrainian, pick the language themselves in the language selector. Both the admin environment and the public pages have been translated.

interface_label_display.title: Interface labels show readable text again
interface_label_display.description: On a number of screens, buttons, menu items and field names appeared as technical codes instead of readable text. Those labels are now displayed correctly everywhere, in each of the available languages.

personal_settings_and_reports.title: Personal settings for every team member, reports split up
personal_settings_and_reports.description: Every team member can now open "My profile" to manage their name, language and password, whatever their role. Within settings you only see the sections that match your role. Reports have also been split: financial overviews such as VAT returns and outstanding invoices are only visible to those who should have access, while commercial analytics stay broadly available. The stock report is now reachable for warehouse staff as well.

marketing_product_editing.title: Marketing role can edit product content
marketing_product_editing.description: Team members with the marketing role can now edit product texts, SEO fields, tags and images. Prices, cost prices, VAT rate, article number, barcode and stock remain reserved for administrators; stock also stays available to the warehouse role.

promotion_permission_scope.title: The right to manage discounts now covers promotions too
promotion_permission_scope.description: The per-member right you set for managing discount codes now also covers every promotion: automatic discounts, volume discounts, buy-one-get-one deals, gift promotions, stacking rules and loyalty programmes. One switch therefore governs the whole permission. In addition, access to some sensitive data is now limited further to the roles that genuinely need it.

sepa_mandate_context.title: SEPA mandates now show amount, reason and interval
sepa_mandate_context.description: When you ask a customer for a recurring SEPA mandate, the authorisation page now states exactly what they are agreeing to: the amount including VAT, the reason and how often it is collected. The amount comes straight from the subscription, so it matches what is charged later.

ticket_signup_counter.title: Signups per date at a glance
ticket_signup_counter.description: See at a glance how many people signed up for each date: a bar and text show occupancy, whether the minimum has been reached and when a date is full. The action buttons per date now also show a tooltip on hover.

ticket_smart_date_actions.title: Manage dates smartly
ticket_smart_date_actions.description: Schedule multiple dates at once with a preview list, move a date to another day, skip a date without deleting it, or merge two dates into one.

ticket_product_dates.title: Sell tickets for events
ticket_product_dates.description: You can now create a product of type Ticket / Event and manage its dates yourself: date, start time, capacity, minimum number of attendees, location and meeting point. For each date you choose a status (scheduled, confirmed, cancelled or completed). You will find this under Products > edit product, in the Events & Dates section, visible as soon as you select the Ticket / Event product type and have saved the product. Bulk date planning will follow in a later update.

odoo_oss_credit_note_tax.title: VAT on refunds of EU sales is now booked with the correct rate
odoo_oss_credit_note_tax.description: When refunding sales to consumers in another EU country, the accounting connection sometimes used the Belgian VAT rate instead of your customer's country rate. This is fixed: credit notes for OSS sales are now booked with the correct country-specific VAT rate. No action needed on your side.

odoo_oss_tax_selection.title: OSS sales are now booked with the correct country-specific VAT rate
odoo_oss_tax_selection.description: If you sell to consumers in another EU country under the EU OSS scheme, the accounting connection sometimes used the Belgian VAT rate instead of your customer's country rate. This is fixed: OSS sales are now booked with the correct country-specific VAT rate. No action needed on your side.

guest_checkout_vat_classification.title: VAT is now correct for orders without a customer account
guest_checkout_vat_classification.description: For guest checkout orders, the VAT on the invoice was not always classified under the correct VAT regime, for example when selling to another EU country or outside the EU. This is fixed: guest orders are now assessed the same way as orders from customers with an account. No action needed on your side.

storefront_section_buttons.title: Buttons in your homepage sections now work everywhere
storefront_section_buttons.description: A button in your hero or text section sometimes took visitors to a page that did not exist, because the link was not tied to your shop. That is fixed: buttons now always lead to the right place in your webshop. If you link to an external website, it now opens in a new tab instead of failing. Nothing to change on your end — existing buttons keep working.

onboarding_existing_customer_fix.title: Shop setup works for existing customers too
onboarding_existing_customer_fix.description: We fixed an issue where creating a shop incorrectly reported that the chosen URL was taken when your email address was already known to SellQo.

onboarding_stays_on_track.title: Setup stays on track
onboarding_stays_on_track.description: We fixed an issue where you could unexpectedly return to the first step while setting up your shop.

onboarding_no_double_create.title: Reliable shop creation
onboarding_no_double_create.description: We fixed an issue where creating your shop could run twice and incorrectly send you back to the first step.

tenant_delete_cascade.title: Clean shop removal
tenant_delete_cascade.description: Deleting a shop now fully cleans up all associated data, so an email address becomes available again afterwards.

onboarding_full_flow.title: Setup runs all the way through
onboarding_full_flow.description: We fixed an issue where shop setup could finish too early, causing you to miss a few steps.

onboarding_nav_ready.title: Ready to go right after setup
onboarding_nav_ready.description: After setting up your shop the full menu is now available immediately, without needing to refresh the page.

auth_session_stability.title: More stable sessions
auth_session_stability.description: We fixed a rare issue where setting up a new shop could stall while verifying your session.

login_setup_polish.title: Smoother login and setup
login_setup_polish.description: You can now easily return to the website from the login page, and the setup wizard scrolls more naturally.

b2b_checkout_custom_frontends.title: B2B checkout for custom storefronts
b2b_checkout_custom_frontends.description: Tenants with a custom storefront can now offer B2B ordering with automatic VAT reverse charging. When a valid EU VAT number is provided, intra-Community supply (art. 39bis) is applied automatically and the customer is invoiced net.

b2b_vat_reverse_charge_fix.title: VAT reverse charge correctly applied at payment
b2b_vat_reverse_charge_fix.description: For B2B orders with a valid EU VAT number, the net amount was shown correctly in checkout but the gross amount was sent to the payment provider. This is resolved: the net amount (excl. VAT) is now correctly processed through to payment.

payment_landing_pages.title: Clean confirmation page after payment via payment link
payment_landing_pages.description: After paying via a payment link you now see a proper confirmation page instead of a 404 error.

refund_button_states.title: Refund button now shows the right state
refund_button_states.description: The refund action on invoices now correctly shows whether a refund or credit note already exists, and can complete an interrupted refund.

refund_cn_fix.title: Refunds now create the credit note correctly
refund_cn_fix.description: When refunding an invoice, the matching credit note was in some cases not created. This has been fixed — the action now creates the credit note, also for invoices that were already refunded.

shipping_classes_entity.title: Shipping classes with a priority rule
shipping_classes_entity.description: Shipping classes are now a real setting: create them, link products in one overview and pick them per shipping method from a list. For orders that mix classes you decide whether the most expensive delivery applies or the costs add up.

shipping_cost_preview.title: Shipping cost visible in the cart
shipping_cost_preview.description: When only one shipping method applies to the items in your cart, its price now shows in the summary — before you enter an address. No surprises at the final step.

variant_photo_gallery.title: Multiple photos per variant
variant_photo_gallery.description: A variant can now carry its own photo gallery: next to the main photo you add extra images per colour or finish. Pick them from your media library and set the order yourself.

credit_note_button_fix.title: Create credit note works everywhere again
credit_note_button_fix.description: The 'Create credit note' action in the invoice menu failed to open a dialog in some views. That is now fixed.

invoice_refund.title: Refunds without the Stripe dashboard
invoice_refund.description: Paid invoices — including subscription invoices — can now be refunded in full straight from SellQo: a single action creates the Stripe refund and the credit note, which flows automatically into your bookkeeping.

per_user_discount_rights.title: Grant discount code access per team member
per_user_discount_rights.description: Admins can now decide per team member with the marketing role whether that person may create and edit discount codes. You manage this via Settings → Team members.

accurate_stats.title: More accurate dashboard statistics
accurate_stats.description: Dashboard and analytics figures now use the same definitions everywhere (paid and not cancelled). Sales channels are recognised correctly and new customers and newsletter subscribers are counted separately.

odoo_accounting.title: Odoo accounting integration
odoo_accounting.description: Per-tenant connection with your own Odoo: invoices and credit notes are booked automatically into your sales journal, including automatic Peppol sending via Odoo for B2B customers.

peppol_status.title: Streamlined Peppol statuses
peppol_status.description: One clear Peppol status per invoice and credit note, with a filter for outstanding Peppol actions in the invoice overview.

billing_sepa.title: Invoicing & SEPA
billing_sepa.description: Native invoicing with SEPA direct debit, automatic reminders (dunning) and credit notes for recurring subscriptions.

shop_health.title: Shop Health Score
shop_health.description: Real-time health monitor for your webshop across 6 areas.

visual_editor.title: Visual Webshop Editor
visual_editor.description: Drag & drop builder for your storefront pages without writing code.

ai_coach.title: AI Business Coach
ai_coach.description: Proactive suggestions based on shop analytics.

unified_inbox.title: Unified Inbox
unified_inbox.description: All customer communication via email centralised in one inbox with AI reply suggestions.

bol_vvb.title: Bol.com VVB labels
bol_vvb.description: Print Fulfilled by Bol shipping labels directly from SellQo.

pos.title: POS checkout system
pos.description: Sell in-person with a touch interface and barcode scanner — perfect for pop-up shops and retail stores.

channel_visibility.title: Sales channels visible in your accounting
channel_visibility.description: In Odoo you now see per journal entry which channel (Bol.com, webshop, ...) a sale came from, with a dedicated aggregate customer per channel. Configure channel names under Accounting.

odoo_draft_mode.title: You choose: post or draft in Odoo
odoo_draft_mode.description: Decide per tenant whether synced invoices are posted immediately or arrive as drafts so your bookkeeper reviews them first.

language_switcher.title: New language selector on the website
language_switcher.description: The language switcher on the public site has been redesigned: a clean menu with full language names instead of flag icons.

connect_overview.title: Clearer integrations overview and readable charts
connect_overview.description: Your Odoo accounting connection now counts in the integrations overview, Shopify import has moved to the Import section, and Analytics charts show product names and order statuses legibly.

reliable_import.title: More reliable data import
reliable_import.description: CSV files that use semicolons as separators and European number formatting (like 19,99) are now processed correctly. Newsletter status is never turned on automatically for imported customers, existing customer data is no longer overwritten on re-import, and the import report shows results per data type.

reliable_notifications.title: Email notifications now work reliably
reliable_notifications.description: If you enabled email notifications for orders, invoices, customers or stock, you now actually receive those alerts by email. Bulk imports no longer trigger a notification storm either.

import_guide.title: Clear export instructions when importing
import_guide.description: When importing, pick your current platform and immediately see how to export your products, customers and orders from it. The import page also received a cleaner, calmer layout.

auth_refresh_fix.title: Forms stay put when switching tabs
auth_refresh_fix.description: When you briefly switched to another tab and came back, a settings screen sometimes reset — filled-in fields were lost and you landed back on the previous page. The session now refreshes silently in the background without reloading the page.

bol_label_integrity.title: Shipping labels stay correctly stored
bol_label_integrity.description: When opening a previously created shipping label, the label of another order could sometimes be shown. Each label is now stored separately and remains correctly retrievable.

help_assistant_free.title: Help assistant free on every plan
help_assistant_free.description: The AI help assistant is now free on every subscription and gives smarter advice about which features are included in your plan and when an upgrade makes sense.

help_assistant_links.title: Working links in the help assistant
help_assistant_links.description: Links from the help assistant to documentation articles now correctly open the right article without reloading the page.

sec_signed_documents.title: Safer download links for invoices and labels
sec_signed_documents.description: Invoices, credit notes and shipping labels now open through short-lived, signed links. Only the store owner can reach these documents.

shipping_classes.title: Shipping classes: match methods to products
shipping_classes.description: Products can now carry a shipping class (for example 'boxspring'). Shipping methods with the same class are only offered when that kind of product is in the cart — universal methods drop out of the list. A customer with a boxspring no longer sees 'Free shipping', and a customer with just a mattress no longer sees the €100 delivery option. Available from the Starter plan onwards.

password_reset.title: Reset your password from the sign-in page
password_reset.description: The sign-in form now includes a 'Forgot password?' button. Enter your email and you'll receive a link to choose a new password. The link is valid for a limited time; check your spam folder if it doesn't arrive.

sec_internal_endpoints.title: Internal admin endpoints further locked down
sec_internal_endpoints.description: A number of maintenance routes now require explicit platform authentication. Unauthenticated access is no longer possible.

sec_tenant_scoped_files.title: Files strictly scoped to your organisation
sec_tenant_scoped_files.description: Uploaded files are now strictly tied to your own organisation. Only your team can add, change or remove them.

shipping_label_downloads.title: Shipping labels download reliably again
shipping_label_downloads.description: Shipping labels: downloading and batch printing labels works reliably again.

sec_rpc_authorization_guards.title: Internal database functions further locked down
sec_rpc_authorization_guards.description: Internal database operations now first verify that you have access to the organisation involved before doing anything. Unused internal functions can no longer be called from the app.

sec_role_scoped_reads.title: Data access tightened per role
sec_role_scoped_reads.description: Team members now only see the data that matches their role. Anything outside their permissions is no longer visible to them.

sec_marketing_role_scope.title: Marketing role permissions tightened
sec_marketing_role_scope.description: The marketing role now only has the permissions that fit that job. Anything outside it is managed with an administrator or staff account.

sec_internal_rpc_hardening.title: Internal database functions locked down
sec_internal_rpc_hardening.description: A set of internal database functions can now only be invoked by the system itself. Unauthenticated access is no longer possible.

sec_role_aware_rls.title: Role-aware access control across the platform
sec_role_aware_rls.description: Large hardening round: every team account sees only the data that matches its role within its own store. Cross-store access is structurally excluded.

stock_report.title: Stock report for any date
stock_report.description: Generate a valued stock list (quantities × cost price) for today or a date in the past — with CSV and Excel export, ready for your accountant.

plan_interval_switch_billing.title: Correct billing when switching billing interval
plan_interval_switch_billing.description: When upgrading a plan and switching between monthly and yearly billing, the pro-rata amount and next invoice date are now calculated correctly, preventing double billing.

stock_ledger.title: Stock ledger: every movement recorded
stock_ledger.description: SellQo now records every stock movement — sales, returns, purchases, syncs and manual corrections — so your stock is exact on any date and fully traceable.

upgrade_invoice_docs_email.title: Invoice document and email for plan upgrades
upgrade_invoice_docs_email.description: Upgrade invoices now automatically receive an invoice document and an email, and failed automatic collections are properly followed up.

subscription_payment_options_foundation.title: Foundation for flexible subscription payment options
subscription_payment_options_foundation.description: The groundwork is in place for more choice in how subscriptions are paid.

subscription_instant_payment_invoice.title: Invoice right after a subscription payment
subscription_instant_payment_invoice.description: As soon as a subscription payment succeeds, the invoice is created automatically as proof of payment and emailed to the customer.

plan_changes_via_team.title: Plan changes temporarily via our team
plan_changes_via_team.description: While we finalize the renewed payment system, plan changes temporarily go through our team.

subscription_payment_requests.title: Payment requests with a payment link for subscriptions
subscription_payment_requests.description: Subscriptions without automatic collection now receive a payment request with a direct payment link and friendly reminders.

self_service_billing.title: Self-service subscription and payment method
self_service_billing.description: Manage your subscription and payment method entirely yourself: direct debit or a payment request per period, and change plan whenever you want.

unified_plan_activation.title: Choose a plan and payment method in one step
unified_plan_activation.description: Choosing a plan and setting up your payment method is now one smooth step, and the mandate page shows exactly what and which amount you are authorising.

trial_pro_features.title: All Pro features during your trial
trial_pro_features.description: During your free 14-day trial you now get to try all Pro features, so you can test the full platform before choosing a plan.

direct_mandate_redirect.title: Straight to the mandate page
direct_mandate_redirect.description: Choosing automatic direct debit now takes you directly to the mandate page. After signing you return automatically and your plan activation is completed for you.

pay_first_upgrades.title: Upgrades are now fully pay-first
pay_first_upgrades.description: Upgrading mid-period now charges exactly the remaining days, based on what you actually pay today — no more full month or double invoice. With direct debit the new plan starts immediately; with a payment request the upgrade starts as soon as the payment arrives. Your billing page shows the pending upgrade with a pay link and the option to cancel while it is unpaid.

billing_documents.title: Invoices and payment requests from a single source
billing_documents.description: Your billing overview now comes straight from the new billing engine: invoices, credit notes and open payment requests with secure PDF downloads.

billing_document_polish.title: Readable invoices and credit notes
billing_document_polish.description: Long descriptions now wrap across multiple lines in invoice and credit note PDFs. Also: a brief network hiccup during a plan change is retried automatically, and the mandate page shows the scheduled plan change with its start date.

vat_display_consistency.title: Prices consistently shown excluding VAT
vat_display_consistency.description: All price displays now clearly and consistently indicate that they exclude VAT.

payment_return_experience.title: Clear payment confirmation
payment_return_experience.description: After paying a payment request you immediately see a clear confirmation and your subscription page updates itself.

billing_engine_migration.title: Subscription billing on our own system
billing_engine_migration.description: Your subscription invoices, payment requests and credit notes now come entirely from our own system, with one clear overview on your subscription page.

customer_invoice_email_fix.title: Correct invoice emails to your customers
customer_invoice_email_fix.description: Invoice emails to your customers no longer show subscription-specific direct debit wording; a paid invoice is confirmed as settled.

platform_newsletter_preference.title: Newsletter preference in settings
platform_newsletter_preference.description: You can now decide in your settings whether you want to receive product updates, tips and news from SellQo by email.

sellqo_blog.title: SellQo Blog — articles, tips and updates in one place
sellqo_blog.description: The SellQo blog is live: in-depth articles with tips, accounting insights and product updates, in Dutch, English, French and German.

app_notification_settings.title: Improved notification settings in the app
app_notification_settings.description: If notifications are switched off on your phone, the app now points this out with a short guide to turn them back on, so you never miss a new order.

security_compliance_docs.title: Public security & compliance documentation
security_compliance_docs.description: SellQo now publishes its security policies at sellqo.app/security: information security, access control, data classification and encryption, incident response and vulnerability management — useful whenever a partner or customer asks about security.

legal_pages_fix.title: Legal pages now display correctly
legal_pages_fix.description: The public pages for terms, privacy, cookies, SLA, acceptable use and the data processing agreement incorrectly showed 'Page not found'. They now display their published content again.

printful_pod.title: Printful print-on-demand integration (beta)
printful_pod.description: You can now connect your Printful store in SellQo Connect, under the new Fulfilment tab. Have products printed and shipped on demand; automatic order forwarding follows in a next release.

connect_availability.title: Clearer view of available and upcoming integrations
connect_availability.description: SellQo Connect now shows at a glance which integrations are live and which are coming soon. Channels that are not available yet get a clear label instead of a button that does nothing.

wide_table_scroll_fix.title: Wide tables now scroll neatly on mobile
wide_table_scroll_fix.description: Overviews with many columns can now be scrolled horizontally on smaller screens, instead of running off-screen.

admin_headers_mobile.title: Admin pages lay out neatly on mobile
admin_headers_mobile.description: Titles and buttons on admin pages now stack correctly on smaller screens.

checkout_country_list.title: Checkout country list follows your shipping settings
checkout_country_list.description: The country selector in checkout only shows countries you actually ship to, in your visitor's language. If you ship to a single country the field is filled in automatically, and an invalid pre-filled country is corrected for you. Custom (headless) frontends now also receive your shop's default country.

vat_checkout_parity.title: Checkout VAT now matches the invoice
vat_checkout_parity.description: Orders outside the EU are now charged without VAT straight away in the checkout (export, article 39 of the Belgian VAT code), and with an active OSS registration we apply the rate of the delivery country. The checkout uses exactly the same VAT rules as the invoice, so the amount your customer pays always matches the invoice and your VAT return.

shipping_countries.title: Shipping countries per shipping method
shipping_countries.description: You now choose per shipping method which countries it applies to, with handy presets for the EU, Benelux and non-EU Europe. Customers only see countries you actually ship to at checkout. Existing shipping methods are limited to the 27 EU countries.

pos_vat_calculation_fix.title: Point of sale now calculates VAT correctly
pos_vat_calculation_fix.description: The point of sale now calculates VAT the same way as your webshop, so amounts add up everywhere.

pos_mobile_layout.title: Point of sale now works smoothly on tablet and phone
pos_mobile_layout.description: The point of sale is now fully usable on smaller screens, with a slide-out shopping cart.

product_page_mobile_fix.title: The product page now works smoothly on mobile
product_page_mobile_fix.description: Buttons, tabs and product variants are now displayed correctly on phones and small screens.

dialog_viewport_fix.title: Dialogs now fit smaller screens
dialog_viewport_fix.description: Pop-up windows now adapt correctly to smaller screens. Long forms scroll inside the window, so buttons such as Save always stay reachable on laptop and mobile.

printful_product_import.title: Import products from Printful
printful_product_import.description: Your Printful designs can now be imported as SellQo products in one click. You first see a preview with all variants, where you can adjust the suggested prices. Images are copied along and variants are linked to Printful automatically, so forwarding works right away. New products arrive inactive and hidden, so you review and publish them yourself.

printful_shipping_updates.title: Automatic shipping updates from Printful
printful_shipping_updates.description: As soon as Printful ships your order, the tracking details arrive in SellQo automatically: the order is marked as shipped and your customer receives the shipping email. Cancellations and holds at Printful also show up on the order page. No setup needed — the integration handles it.

printful_order_forwarding.title: Forward orders to Printful
printful_order_forwarding.description: Send orders to your connected Printful store in one click. Link your variants to Printful products first; the order page then shows the status (draft, confirmed or failed) with a retry button. Gift cards are never forwarded.

event_ticket_types_management.title: Manage ticket types on the event page
event_ticket_types_management.description: The event page now has a Ticket types tab where you create, edit, activate or deactivate ticket types yourself. For each ticket type you link a ticket product (which supplies the name and price), set a sub-capacity, define the sales window with a start and end date, and choose the re-entry policy and sort order. You can see how many have been sold per ticket type and how many spots remain. If you deactivate a ticket type that has sales, or lower its capacity below the number already sold, SellQo asks for confirmation first: new sales stop, existing tickets stay valid and those visitors can still check in. A ticket type with sales cannot be deleted.

event_core_fields_and_live_counter.title: Edit your event in one place, with live occupancy
event_core_fields_and_live_counter.description: Date, time, status, location and capacity of an event are now edited on the event page itself, in the new Settings tab. You can also set capacity to unlimited. If you set an event to cancelled, skipped or merged, or lower the capacity below the number of tickets sold, SellQo asks for confirmation first. The Inside now counter updates live while scanning at the door.

cart_discount_totals.title: Discounts and totals straight from your cart
cart_discount_totals.description: Your cart now always returns the discount amount, shipping cost, VAT and final total. Applying a code that is already active no longer returns an error.

event_checkin_double_scan_and_menu.title: No more double check-ins, and QR scanning now sits under Events
event_checkin_double_scan_and_menu.description: If a ticket QR stayed in front of the camera, the same visitor could sometimes be checked in a second time. That no longer happens: after a scan the scanner waits four seconds before processing the same code again. Ticket check-in now sits under Events in the menu, together with All events. And on the Settings tab of an event your changes stay put when you glance at another tab; saving is only possible once you have actually changed something.

event_quick_actions_and_dashboard_filter.title: Quick actions per event, and your dashboard shows only what is still coming
event_quick_actions_and_dashboard_filter.description: Every event card now has a three-dot menu: edit, open the scanner, duplicate, complete, cancel and delete. Duplicating carries your capacity, location, ticket types and zones over to a new date. Cancelling removes the event from your webshop; existing tickets stay valid. Deleting is only possible for an event without tickets, ticket types or zones — in every other case the button is greyed out with an explanation, so you never run into an unclear error. The dashboard now shows upcoming events only; the Show past switch brings the history back.

ai_content_menu_brand_dna.title: Record your brand DNA and morning menu in Sellqo AI
ai_content_menu_brand_dna.description: Sellqo AI has a new Menu tab. There you describe once who your brand is: mission, audience, tone of voice, selling points, recurring themes, what you do and don't want to say, and hashtag sets you reuse per theme. There is also a free field for anything that doesn't fit a box. Below that you put together your morning menu: for each category you choose how many posts you want, from product post and customer story through to 'surprise me', and you set whether the emphasis is on short, long-form, image-led or carousel posts. If a category is missing, you add your own with its own instruction. That instruction is required, so no category can exist that the generator cannot work with. What you enter here is the basis for the daily content generation that follows. The tab is part of Pro and Enterprise.

ai_daily_menu_generator.title: Sellqo AI puts together your daily menu
ai_daily_menu_generator.description: Under Sellqo AI, the Menu tab now opens with 'Today's menu'. One click and the AI works your morning menu into ready-to-use cards: copy with hashtags per category, in whichever format fits best — post, reel, story or carousel. Each card is shown as a preview the way it would land on the channel, so copy that is too long for a story stands out immediately. The 'surprise me' category picks its own angle based on your brand DNA and what is happening in your shop, and tells you why. Per card you choose: queue it as a draft, adjust it, or discard it. A whole menu costs 5 credits regardless of how many cards it holds. Images are not made automatically — you request one per card for 5 credits, so you only pay for what you use. The feature is part of Pro and Enterprise.

ai_image_tenant_check.title: Tighter access control on AI image generation and marketing insights
ai_image_tenant_check.description: Two AI functions checked whether you were logged in, but not which shop you belong to. In theory that allowed someone to spend another shop's AI credits or pull up their revenue and stock figures. That has been closed: both functions now verify your access to the shop and your role, just like the other AI tools. Nothing changes in how you use them. If you work with team members: image generation is available to admins, staff and the marketing role; insights remain readable for the viewer role as well.

marketing_role_multilingual.title: The marketing workspace now speaks five languages
marketing_role_multilingual.description: Working with a marketing colleague who does not speak Dutch? Every screen the marketing role can open is now fully available in Dutch, English, French, German and Ukrainian: the dashboard, inbox, orders, products, customers, campaigns, SEO, ads, promotions, the translation hub and analytics. That covers more than 200 screens and around 2,500 pieces of text — buttons, labels, tabs, error messages and the notifications that appear after an action. Text in dropdowns, status badges and form validation is included too. You set the language per user in your profile, so everyone sees the admin in their own language, regardless of the webshop's language.

admin_dates_follow_language.title: Dates and times follow your admin language
admin_dates_follow_language.description: Dates in the admin were always in Dutch — even when you used the admin in French or German. You would see 'maandag 4 maart' or '3 dagen geleden' in the middle of a French page. That is fixed: day and month names and relative time expressions now follow the language you set yourself. Amounts stay in the Dutch format, with a comma as the decimal separator — that is an accounting choice, not a language setting.

storefront_customer_email_verification.title: Customers confirm their email address
storefront_customer_email_verification.description: Customers who create an account in your webshop now confirm their email address before they can view their order history. Browsing, ordering and checkout work as before. Customers who already had an account keep their access and need to do nothing.

subscription_invoice_vat_regime.title: Subscription invoices follow your customer's VAT treatment
subscription_invoice_vat_regime.description: Invoices generated from a subscription treated every customer as a consumer: they always received the domestic VAT treatment, even for a business customer with a valid European VAT number. That has been corrected. Subscription invoices now follow the same VAT logic as your webshop invoices: business customers are recorded as business, and with a valid VAT number from another EU country the VAT is reverse charged, including the required statement on the invoice. Domestic rates are unchanged, including the reduced 6% and 12% rates. Invoices that have already been paid are not adjusted retroactively.

bol_ads_period_filter.title: The period selector for Bol ads works again
bol_ads_period_filter.description: Switching between 7, 30 and 90 days kept showing the same seven days. Charts and key figures now follow the period you pick. Bol.com provides at most thirty days of history; the ninety-day view fills in further as days accumulate.

merchant_payout_pages.title: Payouts and transactions load again
merchant_payout_pages.description: The screens showing your Stripe payouts, balance and transactions returned an error instead of your data. They work again. These screens are meant for the administrator and accountant roles.

app_shop_preview_stays.title: The shop preview in the app stays a preview
app_shop_preview_stays.description: Tapping a product inside your shop preview sent the app to your own domain — with no back button, so you had to force-close the app. The preview now stays a preview, including the bar that takes you back.

return_emails_delivered.title: Return emails reach your customer again
return_emails_delivered.description: The emails about a return — request received, approved, package received, amount refunded — were not being sent. Instead they reported that the return could not be found, while it existed all along. They go out again.

admin_floating_bottom_nav.title: The mobile bottom navigation now floats
admin_floating_bottom_nav.description: On your phone, the bottom navigation is now a floating, rounded bar instead of a full-width strip. The shortcuts are Dashboard, Orders, Products and Inbox; the rest of the menu opens from the button at the top left. On an order page it now also shows where you are — it didn't before.

admin_bottom_nav_permissions.title: The bottom bar respects your role
admin_bottom_nav_permissions.description: The mobile navigation bar showed everyone the same tabs, even when your role or your plan doesn't include that page. It now follows the same rules as the side menu: you only see what you can open. The inbox is also properly protected from roles that may not read customer messages.

push_notifications_live.title: Push notifications on your phone
push_notifications_live.description: In Settings → Store notifications, every notification type now has a third switch: push. Turn it on and you'll get, for example, new orders as a notification on your phone, even when the SellQo app is closed. Push is off by default for every type, so you choose what you want. Note: these settings apply to your whole team.

push_notifications_multi_shop.title: Several stores, one phone
push_notifications_multi_shop.description: If you manage more than one store with the same account, the store name now appears in front of the push notification. Tap a notification and the app opens the right screen straight away — switching to the right store first if you had a different one open.

push_per_user.title: You now set up push notifications for yourself
push_per_user.description: Push notifications now apply per person instead of to the whole store. You'll find them under Settings → My notifications: what you turn on there only arrives on your phone, and your team members choose for themselves what they want to receive. You only see the notification types that belong to your role. Had you already turned push on in Store notifications? Turn it on again in My notifications — the old switch is gone.

notifications_follow_role.title: Notifications respect your role
notifications_follow_role.description: Until now, every team member saw all of the store's notifications in the bell, including those about invoices and payments. Notifications now follow the same permissions as the rest of SellQo: a warehouse or marketing team member no longer sees notifications about invoices, quotes, subscriptions or payments. Push notifications on your phone follow the same rule, even if you had turned them on earlier. As an administrator, nothing changes for you.

customer_contact_email.title: Set your own customer contact address
customer_contact_email.description: Under Settings → Email inbox you now choose the email address your customers see in order confirmations, invoices, quotes and newsletters. When a customer replies to one of those emails, the reply arrives at this address. If you leave it empty, we use your store's SellQo inbox address (yourstore@mail.sellqo.app), so replies arrive in your inbox in SellQo. The address you set for your own notifications is no longer shown to customers.

customer_replies_inbox.title: Customer replies arrive in your SellQo inbox
customer_replies_inbox.description: Emails from your store to customers now come from your own SellQo address: yourstore@mail.sellqo.app. When a customer replies, the reply arrives straight in your SellQo inbox, with a notification. Prefer your own email address? Choose it under Settings → Email inbox, at Customer contact email.

contact_form_notification.title: A notification for every contact message from your store
contact_form_notification.description: When a visitor fills in the contact form of your store, you now get a notification under the bell, just like for an incoming email. The message itself is in your inbox. Want a push notification on your phone too? Turn on "Contactformulier" under Settings → My notifications.

notifications_on_by_default.title: Notifications are on by default
notifications_on_by_default.description: You now get push notifications in the SellQo app by default for everything that belongs to your role; turn off what you don't want under Settings → My notifications. Customer messages are also emailed to you by default. If the same customer sends several messages through the same channel in quick succession, you get at most one email per 15 minutes.

notification_opens_item.title: A notification opens the right item straight away
notification_opens_item.description: Tap a notification and you go straight to the order, product or message — in the app and in the browser. For an invoice, the invoice list shows that invoice right away. If the notification belongs to another store you manage, SellQo switches to that store first. If an item can no longer be opened, you land in the list for that kind of item.

all_messages_in_inbox.title: All your customer messages in your SellQo inbox
all_messages_in_inbox.description: Messages sent through the contact form of your store now always arrive in your SellQo inbox, just like customer replies to your emails. When a new message comes in, you get an email showing who sent it and the start of the message, with a button to open it right away. Prefer replies on your own email address? Choose it under Settings → Email inbox, at Customer contact email.

web_app_push.title: Push notifications in the web app
web_app_push.description: Can't install the SellQo app, for example on a work phone? Add SellQo to your home screen and turn on notifications under Settings → My notifications. On iPhone and iPad, do this from Safari via Share → Add to Home Screen. There you also see which devices receive your notifications, and you can disconnect one. If the app and the web app are on the same phone, SellQo asks you to turn off the web app so you don't get anything twice.

shipping_email_customer_language.title: Shipping email in your customer's language
shipping_email_customer_language.description: When you add a tracking number to an order, your customer now gets the shipping email in their own language (Dutch, English, French or German) and in your shop's branding, with a button to track the parcel. The email also shows up in your inbox with the order, and the same shipment is never emailed twice. Shipments that Printful or your carrier mark as shipped automatically get the same email.

event_dates_ready_to_sell.title: Every event date on sale right away, with a clear status
event_dates_ready_to_sell.description: A new date for a ticket product is now on sale right away: the ticket type and the entrance are created automatically. Every date shows whether it's ready to sell and, if not, why (no active ticket type, sales not open yet or already closed, date has passed). A date without a location or meeting point gets a warning, because the ticket email would have no place. 'Add date' and 'Plan multiple dates' now also take an end time, location and meeting point, prefilled from your latest date.

event_wizard_and_door_scanner.title: New event in four steps, and a scanner for your door
event_wizard_and_door_scanner.description: Under Events, 'New event' creates an event in one flow: what, when and where (also weekly recurring), tickets with early bird, and a scan link for your door team. The event is on sale right away. The scan link opens SellQo Door: a full-screen scanner without an account, with a green or red result, vibration and sound, a flashlight, a screen that stays on, and search by name or order number when a QR code won't scan. Add it to your home screen and open it with one tap.

event_workspace.title: Everything about your event on one screen
event_workspace.description: The event page now has four tabs: Overview, Dates, Visitors and Door. On Overview you edit the event's name, photo, description and visibility, the date with times, place, capacity and early bird, and the ticket types. Create a new ticket type such as VIP or Camping with a name and a price, optionally for all upcoming dates at once. Tickets no longer sit among your products, and an empty date can simply be deleted. In the scanner you can also take a photo of the QR code if the live camera won't work.

seating_plans.title: Seating plans: your visitors pick their own seat
seating_plans.description: Under Events → Venues you draw your venue: sections, rows, aisles, price classes, wheelchair and companion spaces. Link the venue to a date and choose a ticket type per price class. In your shop, visitors then pick their own seat; we hold it for 15 minutes while they check out. Every ticket gets its seat, also in the ticket email, and a cancelled ticket frees its seat again. Per show you can take seats off sale and see who sits where.

themes_and_examples.title: Eight new themes and a page full of example shops
themes_and_examples.description: New in the theme gallery: Concert hall & theatre, Festival, Tech & gadgets, Beauty & care, Bar & café, Restaurant & bistro, Wine & delicatessen and Coffee & tea. Each theme comes with a real shop that uses it. At sellqo.app/voorbeelden you can click around all our example shops and place an order: nothing is charged. Also new is the Agenda homepage section, which lists your upcoming events by date.

festival_combos_and_tokens.title: Combo tickets and tokens for festivals
festival_combos_and_tokens.description: Sell a weekend ticket, a combo with camping or a VIP weekend: one purchase, and the buyer gets a separate ticket with a QR code for each day. Also new: tokens for food and drinks. You sell token packs in your shop, the buyer gets one QR code, and at the bar your staff deduct tokens with a bar link on their phone, no account needed. Customers can request a refund for unused tokens themselves: it arrives as a return for you to approve. Find it under Events → Combo tickets and Events → Tokens.

ticket_mail_after_manual_payment.title: Ticket email also after bank transfer payments
ticket_mail_after_manual_payment.description: When a customer pays for tickets or tokens by bank transfer, the ticket email now goes out automatically as soon as you mark the order as paid, including via bank reconciliation or a bulk action. Every order with tickets also shows when the email was sent, and Email tickets again sends it once more.

translated_labels_and_event_menu.title: Combo tickets and Tokens in the menu, more text in your own language
translated_labels_and_event_menu.description: Combo tickets and Tokens are now also in the menu under Events, next to All events, Venues and Ticket check-in. The texts of the Printful integration, the OSS section in the VAT settings, the Odoo status on invoices and credit notes, and the names of your notifications now appear in the language you chose in SellQo.

discount_once_per_customer.title: Discount codes limited to 'once per customer' are now enforced
discount_once_per_customer.description: If you set a discount code so a customer can only use it once, your shop now sticks to that, including for guest orders: the customer is recognised by their email address. An order still waiting for payment by bank transfer already counts. From now on, the number of times used on your discount code only counts paid orders, and a cancelled or refunded order gives the use back.

shipping_health_dashboard_translated.title: Shipping, Shop Health and your dashboard in your own language
shipping_health_dashboard_translated.description: The window for setting up a shipping method, the region presets (EU, Benelux, Europe outside the EU), Shop Health and the widgets on your dashboard now use the language you choose in your profile. Country names and dates follow that language too.

ticket_orders_auto_complete.title: Ticket orders complete themselves
ticket_orders_auto_complete.description: You no longer need to process an order that only contains tickets, combo tickets or tokens: once it's paid and the ticket email has gone out, it's automatically marked Delivered. Ticket orders also show clearer statuses in your order list: Awaiting payment and Tickets sent. Orders that also contain a physical product follow the normal shipping flow.

door_scanner_auto.title: The scanner recognises the event itself
door_scanner_auto.description: You no longer pick an event at the door: the ticket says which event and date it's for. The scanner opens straight away and checks whether the ticket is valid right now, by default from one hour before the start until one hour after the end (adjustable under Events → Door). If a ticket is for another moment, you see it in orange with the right date, and you can still check it in. Also new: the fixed door link, one link for all your events that you add to your home screen once.

social_posts_published.title: Scheduled social posts are now actually published
social_posts_published.description: Posts you schedule for Facebook or Instagram now go live automatically, within the hour after the time you chose. Instagram posts now really end up on Instagram instead of on your Facebook Page, with support for carousels (2 to 10 images). SellQo automatically converts PNG product photos to JPEG on a white background, because Instagram only accepts JPEG. If a post fails, you get a notification with the reason, and after a temporary outage SellQo tries up to three times in total.

social_planning_approval.title: Social planning: approve your posts per week
social_planning_approval.description: Under Marketing → Social planning you see all your planned posts per week, with the image as it will appear on Instagram, the text and the hour. You approve them one by one or a whole week at once, edit the text or hour, or remove a post. Approved posts go live automatically at the planned hour. Posts that can't be published automatically, such as a story with a sticker, are listed too: you open the image, post it yourself and tick it off.

social_reels_reminders.title: Social planning: reels and a reminder for what you post yourself
social_reels_reminders.description: Reels now appear in your Social planning too, with a video preview and a music suggestion. For each reel you choose: let it post automatically in the version with music, or pick a song yourself in the Instagram app. Then you download the video and copy the caption with one tap. For everything you post yourself, such as a story with a sticker or a reel with your own music, you get a notification about an hour beforehand.

social_songs_language.title: Social planning: song suggestions for reels and remaking in another language
social_songs_language.description: For a reel you now get concrete songs to search for in the Instagram music search, with the mood and tempo. And with "Make again" you also choose the language of the new version, for example English for your international followers. The language of each post is shown as a code next to the platform.

social_image_text.title: Social planning: edit the text in your image yourself
social_image_text.description: For posts and stories prepared for you, you can now edit the text in the image itself, such as the title, the price or a bottom line. A preview updates as you type, and before you save you see the image exactly as it will go live. The design stays the same.

social_media_language.title: Social planning: view and download every image, and change the language of a post
social_media_language.description: Under every post you can now view and download each image separately, and for a reel also the video. With "Change language" you translate the caption and the text in the images into another language, for example English; you review everything and see the result before saving.

social_post_now.title: Social planning: post now
social_post_now.description: With "Post now" you put a post from your Social planning live right away, without waiting for the planned time. If it does not work right away, SellQo tries again within the hour.

event_admin_tickets.title: Every ticket separately in the order
event_admin_tickets.description: An order with tickets now shows every ticket separately: the event and date, the ticket type, the holder's name, the end of the ticket code and the status (valid, checked in with the time, or cancelled). That way you can answer a visitor's question without opening the scanner.

ticket_cancel_ordernumbers.title: Cancelled tickets become void, and no more duplicate order numbers
ticket_cancel_ordernumbers.description: When you cancel an order or refund it in full, the tickets that haven't been scanned yet become void: they no longer get in at the door and the spots become available again. Two orders placed at the same moment now always get their own order number, so a busy ticket sale no longer runs into an error. And if someone pays just as your event sells out, you get an urgent notification right away so you can help that customer.

door_scanner_bad_network.title: The door scanner keeps working with poor reception
door_scanner_bad_network.description: The door scanner no longer waits endlessly: after 8 seconds without an answer it tries once more, and during a scan you can see it is busy. Scans that come in while a scan is running wait their turn. Without a connection you get a grey "No connection" message with a button to try again, instead of a red "invalid". At the top you can see whether your device is online. If your check-in did arrive but the answer did not, a new attempt on the same device within 30 seconds simply shows "Welcome" instead of "Already inside". A cancelled or refunded ticket now says exactly that, instead of "Invalid ticket".

ticket_order_cancel_delivered.title: Ticket orders can still be cancelled after the ticket email
ticket_order_cancel_delivered.description: An order with only tickets, combo tickets or tokens is set to Delivered as soon as the ticket email goes out. Until now you could then only cancel it through a status correction. Now you simply pick Cancelled as the order status: tickets that have not been scanned yet are voided right away and the spots become available again. Orders with a regular product follow the shipping flow as before.

free_checkout_faster.title: Checking out free tickets is faster
free_checkout_faster.description: When a customer checks out an order of €0, for example with a 100% discount code, they now get the confirmation right away instead of after about ten seconds. The invoice, the order confirmation and the ticket email are sent afterwards, in the same order as before.

admin_dead_controls_cleanup.title: Fewer buttons that did nothing in the translation hub, your profile and the till
admin_dead_controls_cleanup.description: The translation hub no longer shows switches for automatic translation: they were saved, but nothing ever used them. You translate per item or in bulk. A gift card you print at the till now gets a real QR code with the card code, instead of a box that only looked like one. The camera button in your profile, which was always disabled, is gone. An AI suggestion about stock now takes you to your low-stock products instead of a purchasing page where you could not create anything.

homepage_sections_slideshow_logos_column.title: Four new homepage sections, video that loads only after a click, and an image picker
homepage_sections_slideshow_logos_column.description: In the webshop editor you can now add four new sections to your homepage: a slideshow, a strip of logos and brands, columns (two to four blocks side by side) and a standalone text block. A video section first shows only a play button: the YouTube or Vimeo player loads only when your visitor clicks it, and until then no request goes to YouTube or Vimeo (unless you turn on autoplay). With the Store reviews section you show your reviews from Google, Trustpilot and other platforms, with your average score; without reviews it stays hidden. The questions and answers from your FAQ section are now also included as structured data on your homepage, so Google and other search engines can read them. You choose or upload images for slides, logos and columns with the image picker instead of pasting a link.
